text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's Agnes Tachyon crossing the
finish line, in
a tremendous display of
dominance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may be the living embodiment of an
enigma,
but her running never ceases to
amaze me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see... This is... truly fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. You're in a fine mood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From her debut race to the end of the
Classics,
she's dominated the track.
We've got this in
check!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho G1 race is the next up in
your
agenda, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmmm. It is a fine goal! However...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, I'd like it if you didn't
place
too much faith in me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What does she mean by that? In any
case, it
seems our goal hasn't changed...
for the time
being.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite this uncertainty lingering in the
back of
my mind, our days training for
the Kikuka Sho
begin in earnest!
